question: What is the sentinel value abstraction pattern that NotSetType implements within the pytest compatibility layer to decouple internal state representation from external API contracts?
answer: It is a single-member `enum.Enum` — `class NotSetType(enum.Enum): token = 0` — whose sole member is exported as the module-level singleton `NOTSET`, used as a default parameter value to uniquely represent "argument not supplied" so internal code can distinguish absence from any valid caller value (including `None`).
